name: GEF Small Grants Programme Malawi
summary: Malawi's SGP country programme funds community-based organisations and NGOs for environmental projects, with OP8 grantmaking focused on the Mzimba, Rumphi and Nkhata Bay landscape.
reporting: Grantees monitor their own projects and submit mid-term or progress reports and final reports; the national secretariat also checks progress against indicators through site visits.

steps: Concept paper to the National Coordinator

eligibility.rule: Project objectives and activities demonstrate impact in GEF focal areas
Proposed project aligns with the country SGP strategy
Include vulnerable-group participation in the project

administered_by.quote: Address C/O UNDP Malawi, Plot 7 Area 40

applicant_types.quote: The programme provides grants of up to $50,000 directly to local communities, including community-based organisations and other non-governmental groups

geography.quote: the existing landscape comprising Mzimba, Rumphi, and Nkhata Bay was retained for OP8 implementation.

access.quote: The call for proposals will stipulate that each project invests 4-6% of the total grant amount on project level monitoring and evaluation.

amount.quote: The programme provides grants of up to $50,000 directly to local communities

reporting.quote: The SGP National Secretariat will monitor grantees' progress towards meeting the indicators through site visits, mid-term/progress and final reports and update the country database.

effort.quote: the proponent prepares a brief project concept paper and submits thisto the coordinator.
The national coordinator reviews and pre-screens the concept paper
If the project isjudged eligible,the project proponent prepares a project proposal;

eligibility.quote: How the proposed project proposal meets the GEF SGP criteria by articulating how project objectives and activities would have an impact in the SGP areas of work -GEF focal areas-.
How they respond or are aligned to the targets and objectives of the SGP Country Programme Strategy(CPS) of their country.
participation of vulnerable groups is a requirement for all projects

after_award.quote: The grantees implementing projects will be required to compile periodical reports (quarterly and annual reports) to provide updates on project implementation progress.
The SGP National Secretariat will monitor grantees' progress towards meeting the indicators through site visits, mid-term/progress and final reports and update the country database.
